reason: Individual shared-controller pin PRs failed the provenance contract and launched expensive qualification before consistency was checked. Routine Go updates also competed with the authenticated security proposer.
changes: Run complete controller/collector consistency preflight before native and matrix jobs.
Group shared-controller Dependabot references into one discovery PR.
Use the authenticated security proposer for Go fixes; stop the separate routine-version PR queue.
Serialize writable synthetic executable creation against fork so parallel integration tests cannot transiently fail with ETXTBSY.
rollout: Adopt the newly qualified immutable platform controller in a separate complete bundle after the platform repair is published. This bootstrap does not claim that rollout is complete.
approval: Independent human review is required after all CI passes.

additional_failure.reproduction: A race-enabled isolated Linux run with the failing shuffle seed, test.parallel=32 and count=12 reproduced fork/exec /proc/self/fd/3: text file busy and the deadline assertion failure.
additional_failure.cause: A concurrent fork inherits an open writable fixture until its exec. Closing the parent descriptor is insufficient; O_CLOEXEC only closes the child copy during exec.
additional_failure.repair: Hold syscall.ForkLock for reading through fixture creation, copying and descriptor closure. No production command behavior or deadline assertions change.
additional_failure.validation: The identical race-enabled concurrent stress command passes all 12 runs after the fix. Fresh hosted CI remains required before review.
